name: css-card-stacking
title: CSS Card Stacking
blurb: Sticky cards stack and overlap as you scroll, using CSS position:sticky.
description: A scroll-based card stacking effect using CSS sticky positioning. Multiple cards layer on top of each other as the user scrolls. Uses ReactLenis for smooth scrolling. Cards contain titles, descriptions, and links.
use_when: Scroll narratives, step-by-step guides, or component showcases where stacking adds visual structure.
avoid_when: When all content needs to be visible at once — sticky stacking hides earlier cards.
a11y: All text is readable. Links are proper anchors. Sticky positioning doesn't hide content permanently.
